title: ジャパンCの後に・跳ね返されても

text_block_list.text: Rumble…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaah! I won't lose… I won't loooose!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Whoaaah, how unrelenting! But I won't make this easy for you! Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And the winner of the Japan Cup is T.M. Opera O! However…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto pulled out all the stops! She showed us a new version of herself, her vicious running piled on the pressure!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… I couldn't… surpass you. But…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: What is this… I'm feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I feel all fuzzy on the inside… and shiny on the outside… and really, really happy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Is this… the real me? If I keep this up, just maybe…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'll truly shine!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Doto…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Why… hadn't you done this earlier?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh… "why"?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I felt it today. You closed on me like a ferocious lion. You stirred your charisma from its slumber deep within you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Think of the wonderful revues we could have created, had you exercised the power you displayed today.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: If you have been abating your talents until now, I ask that you cease at once. Rain down on me like an unrelenting tempest!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I shall defeat you at your full power and then go on to defeat the previous generation. Understood?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'll follow your lead—I mean…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best. Let's raise the ante, as rivals!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What the heck?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Her lap time! It might not seem like a huge difference, but that was faster than the maximum possible value for her stats…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I thought your limits were supposed to be absolute. I fought that ceiling for nothing, and then those two just casually shatter it?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I don't get it. The previous generation have the higher stats, but…

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The Three Goddesses must've loaded the dice in their favor!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Looks like the Arima Kinen is going to be tons of fun, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe… after watching this race… that's what comes to mind?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah! I'm more pumped up than ever. Doto and T.M. Opera O are getting really strong. And…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That makes me really happy! Just think how exciting things will be if everyone keeps revving it up!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …You know what? You're right. Sorry, my reaction was uncalled for.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I cannot bear to stand here trembling. I will knock them down, regally and with poise.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Traineeeer! Oh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much. I didn't win today, but I… I…
choice_data_list: It won't be long before you reach your dream.
It won't be long before you reach your dream.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes! I definitely… definitely want to run in the Arima Kinen next! That's where…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll finally become a racing star! I'll win against Opera O, the previous generation… and I'll shine more than anyone else!
Meisho Doto realizes her full potential, giving up her attachment to T.M. Opera O.
Our next match is the Arima Kinen. Only victory will reunite us with the splendor seen in our dreams!
